text:
Maya Li: Quick heads-up: rolling a smoke for 'mistral-lite-2' int4 (ptq) on staging to run jailbreak + toxicity probes. Short run, want fast signal on softrefusals.
Jon Carter: Watching perf + KV. Which preset?
Maya Li: Using `intel-4q-low`. Deploy command:```rwc deploy --model mistral-lite-2 --quant int4 --preset intel-4q-low --env staging```
ops-bot: Redteam queued: id=RT-4850 tests=[JB-basic, JB-chain, Toxicity-v3] status=running :hourglass:
Priya Desai: Local smoke earlier showed a "softflip" on a nested instruction chain: model refuses, then after a short prompt tweak outputs actionable text. Not stable but concerning.
Jon Carter: Noted a p99 bump to 200-220ms during JB-chain. KV hit down to ~0.6. Logged perf snippet to INF-2941.
Maya Li: Can we repro with greedy (temp=0, top_k=1) to see if quant changes deterministic tie-breaks?
Priya Desai: Running seed sweep now:```rwc run --model mistral-lite-2 --quant int4 --temp 0 --top_k 1 --seeds 1-10 --prompt prompts/hard_jb.json``` Will post matrix.
ops-bot: Redteam finished: RT-4850 summary: softflips=1, jailbreaks=5, tox_flags=9. Full: https://reports/internal/RT-4850 :mag:
Jon Carter: Repro looks like greedy flips at specific seeds (2/8). Suggest adding a canary fallback: if jailbreak heuristic score > 0.7 or repeated softrefusal pattern, route to `mistral-lite-2-fp16`.
Maya Li: Agree. Priya, can you add sampling/logit dumps for the failing seeds? Also add the prompt-set to the sampling audit job.
Priya Desai: Will do. Dropping first dump to RT-4850 thread and opening a follow-up INF ticket for kernel/memory if perf traces show triton mismatch.
Maya Li: Thanks. We'll reconvene after audit matrix. Keep notes short. :white_check_mark:
